title: New Bounds for Exact Penalized Cardinality-Constrained Optimization with Pseudonormality Conditions
summary: Cardinality-constrained optimization (CCO) is a popular topic in sparse learning and signal recovery, yet remains challenging due to the inherent nonconvexity and discontinuity of cardinality constraints. This paper investigates the exact penalty theory for CCO problems with general equality and inequality constraints. In particular, we extend the pseudonormality condition to the cardinality-constrained framework and establish the local exact penalization without imposing Lipschitz continuity on the objective function.
